{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values and sentinel values
print("Missing values in customer_age:")
print(sales_df['customer_age'].isnull().sum())

print("\nUnique values in customer_age:")
print(sales_df['customer_age'].unique())

# Check how many customers have age = -1
age_neg1_count = (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"\nNumber of customers with age = -1: {age_neg1_count}")"}
